name: infinite-moving-cards
title: Infinite Moving Cards
description: A horizontal strip of dark rounded testimonial cards that scrolls sideways on a loop, the list duplicated so it never ends. Each card holds a quote, a name and a role.
use: Several testimonials need to cycle through a narrow band without arrows or dots.
avoid: Visitors need to read every quote at their own pace, or motion must stop for accessibility.
a11y: Continuous motion with no pause control except hover and no reduced-motion check, so touch users cannot stop it. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A band of wide, dark rounded cards on black, each carrying two or three lines of pale grey quote text and, below, a name and job title in smaller grey type. Cards run off both edges and fade into the black through a soft gradient mask.
behaves: The cards slide steadily leftward and loop without a seam because the whole list is cloned. Hovering any card pauses the slide, and it picks up again when the pointer leaves.
customise: items supplies each quote, name and title, and direction, speed and pauseOnHover are props. Card width, colours and the edge fade live in the classes.
weight: light: One CSS keyframe moving a duplicated list of quote cards.

props.name: items
props.type: { quote: string; name: string; title: string }[]
